denial_class_contract.note: REMEDIATION-07 G4. A negative case is PASS only when the observed (SQLSTATE, message family) pair matches the resolved authorization-denial rule EXACTLY. The pair is compared FIRST; only if it does not match is the outcome classified as CASE_INFRASTRUCTURE_OR_UNEXPECTED_DENIAL. SQLSTATE 42501 is an authorization SQLSTATE for this contract because the production RPCs raise their direct-assignee denials with ERRCODE 42501; a 42501 whose message is not in the resolved family is still a HOLD.

resolution_rules.contract_note: REMEDIATION-09 G1. In act_on_b1_student_request_step_atomic the authorization gate can_current_user_act_on_step(p_step_id, v_action) runs BEFORE the v_config.action_type comparison, and can_current_user_act_on_step itself returns false when the passed action differs from the configured action_type. An exact direct assignee sending an illegal action is therefore denied with ERRCODE 42501 and message B1_DIRECT_ASSIGNEE_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED. B1_ACTION_TYPE_MISMATCH is unreachable from any external caller and must never be expected.

REMEDIATION-09 G2. Department-scope swaps are denied by the direct-assignee gate because the scope-bound assignment never resolves to the acting user. B1_ACTIVE_STEP_REQUIRED is NOT an acceptable proof of scope enforcement, so these cases are only executable against an ACTIVE transfer head step.
